description: This file registers CLI commands related to message permissions and search functionalities for a Discord bot. It defines functions to set up 'permissions' and 'search' commands with respective options.

methods.name: export function registerMessagePermissionsCommand(message: Command, helpers: MessageCliHelpers) / registerMessagePermissionsCommand
methods.description: Registers the 'permissions' command in the CLI, which fetches channel permissions.

methods.name: export function registerMessageSearchCommand(message: Command, helpers: MessageCliHelpers) { registerMessageSearchCommand
methods.description: Registers the 'search' command in the CLI, which searches Discord messages with specified options.
